name: Issue 1877: Burned Etching adds 10% Fire damage to Elemental Burst and 5% Fire Engraving chance
contract: Burned Etching 500476 (Runemaster Glyphic talent, CharacterAdvancement 31128) reads 'While Weapon Engraving:
Fire is active, your Elemental Burst now deals $s1% (10%) increased damage as Fire damage and your chance to
trigger Weapon Engraving: Fire is increased by $500475s2% (5%).' Its only effect is PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 500475
with Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0, so nothing applied 500475. 500475 effect 0 is Ascension aura 354, BasePoints 9 (10),
trigger 500474, a Fire SCHOOL_DAMAGE hit that cannot crit and ignores caster and taken modifiers; effect 1 is a
flat SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS (18) +5 on family 38 mask1 0x2, which Fire Engraving 653211 carries. 653211 is
the equip spell of the Weapon Engraving: Fire enchant 1000, active exactly while the engraving is, ProcChance 30
(Aura::CalcProcChance applies SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS). It is applied as a fixture aura because the scenario
format has no item target for cast. Elemental Burst ranks (802202, 502828-502838) are the magic-class family 38
spells with mask2 0x20000. Expected: Fire Engraving alone gives no 500475, keeps the chance at 30 and no extra
Fire hit; with the talent and the engraving, 500475 is on the Runemaster, the chance reads 35, and one Elemental
Burst hit is followed by one 500474 hit worth 10% of it (integer truncation: 0.0985-0.1001 of a ~3700 hit); when
the engraving ends or the talent is removed, 500475 goes away, the chance is 30 again and no Fire hit follows.
